records.rule: Do not detect SETMETHOD entries by sending INDEX or HASINDEX: the entry's method runs. Detect object state by calibrated field offsets read without sending messages.
FORWARD inside a ::ROUTINE helper raises 98.947; a helper that re-sends a message uses sendWith.
An activation takes its package's security manager when it starts. Setting a manager mid-routine does not cover that routine's own calls or commands.
Helper routines must not use dot symbols (.context, .local): each is a LOCAL request the user's security manager would see. Use RX2CPP_CALLER_CONTEXT and RX2CPP_TAKE.
An object's string value is REQUEST('STRING') first, then STRING with NOSTRING (RexxInternalObject::requestString); calling STRING twice printed an extra NOMETHOD message.

records.topic: first read of a method entry
records.rule: FindClass on a name whose .environment entry is a SETMETHOD method runs it; look classes up in the package's own class directories first (packageClass).
Delete previous output before comparing: an old dump file gave a false IDENTICAL.
Large generated libraries (Rexx Parser) need the machine to themselves: cc1plus was OOM-killed beside other builds.
Check ooRexx trunk before writing an interpreter ticket: bug 5 had been fixed in r13259.
RexxThreadInterface ends with four object fields (RexxNil, RexxTrue, RexxFalse, RexxNullString); the size assert counts them.
A source file ending in a lone CR (the Rexx Parser's Elements.cls) needs a final LF added when copied for a build.

Allocating interpreter objects where the interpreter allocates none (copies of a package's class tables at each first class lookup) changes when an object becomes collectable (test_object_lifetime.sh: after 1 GC instead of 2). Take such copies once at load; look up without allocating.

.environment always has one SETMETHOD entry (LOCAL, ActivityManager::getLocalRexx), so 'no method table' meant nothing was ever kept (3.46 million lookups a parser pass). Decide per name: a Directory runs a method entry only for a name it has no entry for. Count cache hits before trusting a cache.

The String comparison methods answer a .nil operand directly (CompareOperator, notEqual, primitiveIsEqual); asking .nil for a string sent MAKESTRING (NOMETHOD) and could raise a NOSTRING the interpreter never raises.

A gate qualifies the commit it ran on. e3d8d00 was merged on a benchmark of 61285d6; fa1179f's speed regression (55 s to 103 s on pbench2) had passed the full regression and the fixed point. After every merge, run pbench2 on the exact merged commit (e3d8d00: 54.1 s against 144.8 s interpreted, 2.68x).

A C++ exception scans the unwind table of every frame it crosses; a generated method body is one huge function, so each throw cost about 300,000 instructions. EXIT in internal routines threw MethodExit 9,110 times a pass of the Rexx Parser (10% of the run): a CALL now returns it through _rxExitPending.

A native object made into an interpreter object (an interpreter Stem, StringTable, Set holds it) is held from outside; if native garbage holds that collection, neither collector can free it. Keep collections native (stem []= of an object, ITEMS, UNION) and find the roots with RX2CPP_GC_STATS=3.
A statistic counter must cost nothing when off: test the flag before making its name (bifStatsOn). A literal name turned into std::string first cost 3.4 million allocations a pass.

When gdb sampling shows no hotspot, callgrind's exact instruction counts and caller tree do: the remaining costs were thread-local lookups, mutexes, string copies and exception unwinding, each a few percent.
Two pbench2 builds at once run out of memory (cc1plus killed): build one at a time; a regression beside one build is fine.
